comparison_against_previous_12.why_meaningfully_distinct: The custom-automation article decides how bespoke the architecture should be. This page decides whether individual workflow steps need model-based interpretation at all, versus explicit deterministic rules. Readiness and prioritisation pages address earlier decisions.

latest_publication.original_editorial_asset: The Olivers Consulting certainty test: define whether the answer is exact, whether inputs are too variable for rules, whether AI output can be checked before consequential action, and whether the workflow can stop safely when confidence is low. The article also provides a six-stage hybrid workflow model.
latest_publication.first_hand_contribution_or_limits: Uses practical automation, business-analysis, data-quality and control-design judgement. The certainty test is explicitly framed as an Olivers Consulting decision aid rather than an empirical industry standard.
latest_publication.proof_points_used_recently: No fabricated client result, savings claim, search-volume figure or unsupported market statistic is used.
